But let's cut through the noise: The real issue is VA's bloated bureaucracy. Section 4(c) of the ACCESS Act allows private contractors to charge 22% more per patient than VA facilities while delivering worse outcomes. That's not efficiency—it's theft.

The FARM Act (S. 1202) shows how to actually support rural communities—by investing in local infrastructure, not outsourcing care to profit-driven corporations. Veterans deserve medical sovereignty, not another layer of corporate billing departments. Accountability matters. Exposing waste ≠ attacking care. Real reform starts with auditing the 83,000 administrative bloat positions added since 2021, not stripping frontline workers' collective bargaining rights to report mismanagement.
